text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Unusual surge detected for model_family=argus6b. TPM spiked from ~1.2k -> ~4.2k in 3m. 95th latency > SLO (1.8s -> 3.9s). 5xx rate up 1.8x. Auto-surge-policy triggered.

Priya S: paging oncall — @Mike L you up? this looks like a live mitigation situation.

Mike L: oncall here, seeing the alert. joining. has RU metrics?

Alex H: pushing quick dashboards — tail latency and queue length show headroom exhaustion on the argus6b pools (gpu-pool-3). traffic pattern: lots of short chat completions from free tier + a bursty enterprise test.

Sam K: initial thought: sculpt per-model quotas (TPM/RPM) for argus6b to protect overall cluster latency. recommend drop TPM -> 400, RPM -> 40 as an emergency throttle while we triage. also consider disabling streaming on argus6b to reduce small-chunk overhead.

Mike L: ok. want minimal customer impact. can we whitelist enterprise reserved customers (dedicated pools) and only sculpt PLG/hosted traffic?

Account SRE: confirmed a few paying enterprise customers are on dedicated capacity and unaffected. a subset of mid-market customers on shared hosted are seeing 429s. list: alpha-social, beta-search (low severity), gamma-ads (medium but not offline).

Priya S: run the quota change, include reason and runbook link. I'll notify CS and SRE.

Mike L: running command now (redwood-admin CLI):
```
# emergency per-model quota adjust for argus6b
redwood-admin quota adjust --model-family argus6b --tpm 400 --rpm 40 --scope hosted --reason "emergency sculpt 2198880000"
```

ops-bot: command accepted. initiating quota update across control plane. request id: rq_8b3f2d.

ops-bot: quota update applied to route=hosted, model_family=argus6b: tpm=400 rpm=40. propagation expected < 30s.

Mike L: also toggled streaming=false for argus6b on hosted route to reduce event overhead.

ops-bot: feature flag update success: model_family=argus6b route=hosted streaming=false.

Alex H: metrics after 60s: ingress TPS dropped to ~900, 95th latency back to ~1.2s, 5xx down to baseline. queue length on gpu-pool-3 reduced. looks stable for now.

Account SRE: getting customer reports: alpha-social seeing 429s but they fall back gracefully. CS informed.

Sam K: good. next steps: keep sculpt in place for 30m, monitor QPS and SLOs, run targeted evals to check quality for pinned customers. prepare rollback plan if traffic returns to normal.

Mike L: adding temporary allowance for enterprise customers on hosted route with reserved tags — exempting two accounts (alpha-social-enterprise, gamma-ads-reserved) so they don't hit the new quota while we stabilize. command:
```
redwood-admin quota allow --model-family argus6b --account alpha-social-enterprise --tpm 2000 --rpm 200 --reason "temporary exception during sculpt"
redwood-admin quota allow --model-family argus6b --account gamma-ads-reserved --tpm 1500 --rpm 150 --reason "temporary exception during sculpt"
```

ops-bot: allowance rules applied.

Priya S: I'm going to start a brief incident blameless note and notify customer-facing teams: impact scope, mitigation steps, ETA for re-eval.

Maya R: I'm taking handoff at +30. will watch for regressions and coordinate with infra to scale pool or move some agents off argus6b if needed.

Mike L: sanity check — no config mistakes in the commands? confirm logs show successful propagation.

ops-bot: propagation complete. all control plane writes propagated to edge in ~22s. audit log id: audit_2198880000_1.

Alex H: saving snapshots: cpu/gpu utilization, tail-latency charts, and top n customers by token for the last 30m. linking in the incident doc.

Account SRE: flagged accounts with customer success. CS will open support threads for those who hit rate limits.

Priya S: decision: keep sculpted quotas and streaming disabled for argus6b for 30m, then re-evaluate auto-scale and longer-term shaping. escalation criteria: if 95th latency > 1.5s or 5xx > 1.5x baseline, escalate to oncall+infra.

Mike L: noted. I'll monitor next 30m and post final status here. handing over to Maya at +30.

Maya R: acknowledged, taking over. please DM if anything urgent.

Priya S: :thumbsup: thanks team. adding runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/model-sculpting and incident doc: https://redwood.internal/incidents/2198880000

Mike L: closing live thread — mitigation in place, metrics stable. will follow up with a short postmortem if this recurs.

incident-bot: Incident note: mitigation applied (per-model quota sculpt, streaming disabled). State=stabilized.
